import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem Shakarchi_exercise_1_19b_mutation (z : ℂ) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ p)) :
    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun i => z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ p
  have hnorm : Summable (fun i : ℕ => ‖f i‖) := by
    simpa [f, norm_div, norm_pow, hz, Nat.cast_add, RCLike.norm_natCast] using
      (summable_pow_div_add z p 1 hp)
  have hsummable : Summable f := hnorm.of_norm
  refine ⟨∑' i, f i, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  simpa [f] using hsummable.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
